name: Palisades Fire
summary: Started the same morning as the Eaton Fire, in the Santa Monica Mountains above Pacific Palisades. Driven by the same winds, it destroyed nearly 7,000 structures and burned about 23,000 acres.
glendale_link: Same weather pattern, same kind of wildland-urban interface as Glendale.
